about: Cards the owner's audit of 2026-10-02 holds back from the site (DESIGN-LAW rule 105). Every live card was looked at on contact sheets; a card is held when it is not a finished product: no photograph behind it, or a headline that does not read. scripts/hold_showcase.mjs --write stamps defect "curated" on each, which every later audit keeps. Delete a line here and the stamp from index.json to bring a card back. The composition audit of 2026-10-03 (DESIGN-LAW rule 109) added the rows marked audit 2026-10-03: cards whose parts collide in a way centring cannot mend. Rows marked audit 2026-10-04: one alignment to a card (the owner: "align left for everything ... or if you're going to center it then you can't leave the second line of the hero aligned left").
